title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Hosea 7: hearts like an oven, Ephraim as a pancake not turned over, and the easily deceived dove calling to Egypt.

questions.text: What does this chapter say happens when Yahweh would heal Israel?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when he would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered and also the wickedness of Samaria.

answers.text: The people turn back to him with weeping and fasting
The princes of the land come to seek his face
The iniquity of Ephraim and the wickedness of Samaria are uncovered
The altars of the high places are broken down

questions.text: With what do they make the king glad and the princes glad, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says they make the king glad with their wickedness and the princes with their lies.

answers.text: With their wickedness, and with their lies
With their silver, and with their gold
With their songs, and with their feasts
With their tribute, and with their oaths

questions.text: What happened on the day of our king, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says that on the day of our king the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine, and he joined his hand with mockers.

answers.text: The people brought gifts to his house
The priests anointed him with oil
The judges were devoured in the gate
The princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine

questions.text: What is Ephraim called in this chapter, in the picture taken from baking?
questions.explanation: The verse says Ephraim mixes himself among the nations, and that Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

answers.text: An oven left cold all night
A pancake not turned over
A loaf without leaven
A measure of unsifted flour

questions.text: What does the chapter say is here and there on him, without his realizing it?
questions.explanation: The verse says strangers have devoured his strength and he does not realize it, and that gray hairs are here and there on him, and he does not realize it.

answers.text: Open wounds
Marks of the yoke
Gray hairs
Spots of leprosy

questions.text: What bird is Ephraim compared with, and to which two countries do they turn?
questions.explanation: The verse says Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding, and that they call to Egypt and go to Assyria.

answers.text: An easily deceived dove, and they call to Egypt and go to Assyria
A wandering sparrow, and they call to Tyre and go to Moab
A screeching eagle, and they call to Kittim and go to Edom
A silent raven, and they call to Gilead and go to Shechem

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will do when they go?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when they go he will spread his net on them and bring them down like the birds of the sky, and will chastise them.

answers.text: He will hide his face and let them pass by
He will break their bows and burn their chariots
He will call them back with the sound of a trumpet
He will spread his net on them and bring them down

questions.text: What does the chapter say they have not done with their heart?
questions.explanation: The verse says they have not cried to him with their heart, but howl on their beds, assemble themselves for grain and new wine, and turn away from him.

answers.text: They have not kept his law in their heart
They have not cried to him with their heart
They have not loved their brothers from the heart
They have not remembered Egypt in their heart

questions.text: What do they do even though Yahweh has taught and strengthened their arms?
questions.explanation: The verse says that though he has taught and strengthened their arms, they plot evil against him.

answers.text: They give their strength to strangers
They boast in their own wisdom
They plot evil against him
They turn their swords on each other

questions.text: What are they compared with in the last verse, when they return but not to the Most High?
questions.explanation: The verse says they return but not to the Most High, and that they are like a faulty bow, and their princes will fall by the sword.

answers.text: A faulty bow
A broken staff
A leaking jar
A snapped cord
